ctaHeading: Need Landscaping in Truganina? Let's Talk.
aboutText: Werribee Landscaping Services is based in Truganina, offering affordable and quality landscaping and garden maintenance across Melbourne's western suburbs. Our experienced team handles all projects from households to businesses, ensuring a fresh outlook for your garden. We build personal relationships to meet all criteria and achieve complete satisfaction.
servicesText: From initial design to ongoing care, we provide a range of landscaping services. Our team specialises in creating beautiful, functional outdoor spaces tailored to your needs and budget.

services.title: Garden Design
services.desc: We craft custom garden designs that enhance the beauty and functionality of your outdoor area.

services.title: Landscape Construction
services.desc: Building gardens from the ground up, including walls, paths, and planting for lasting results.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep to keep your garden looking its best, including mowing, pruning, and weeding.

services.title: Paving & Retaining Walls
services.desc: Expert installation of durable paving and retaining walls to define your garden spaces.

services.title: Lawn Care & Turfing
services.desc: Laying new turf or maintaining existing lawns for a lush, green carpet underfoot.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Care
services.desc: Pruning, shaping, and caring for trees and shrubs to promote healthy growth and appearance.
